agent_position: Startup creates the implicit VM default when no pool document is configured (D1a), keeping implicit default membership for hosts
owner_disposition: No implicit default and no seeded pool: a host's pool becomes optional (nullable hosts.pool_id); a host written without a pool is unplaced and never sold; explicit null on update or import unplaces it through the pool-change hooks. A site administrator who names no pool must never accidentally lease a host, and API registration and seeding/import must behave alike
summary: Host pool membership becomes optional instead of seeding a default pool at runtime

agent_position: B1: baseline the 21 migrations before 2026-09-21, moving migration-only DDL such as the partial relay-lease index into the models, recording their IDs on fresh databases, and refusing partial history
owner_disposition: B2: keep the 21 entries and their IDs and strip their bodies to schema-only work, removing their data rewrites; the longer-term strategy for retiring old migrations belongs to a separate change
summary: Pre-2026-09-21 migrations are hollowed to schema-only rather than baselined

agent_position: Each adapter bundle contributes its seed pool (a new ExecutorAdapterBundle field), created in one transaction through a new session-scoped create when no pool document is configured and no pool is stored
owner_disposition: A seed document packaged with the provisioning service and named by default configuration (pool_seed_path), applied once through the existing document import on a fresh site with no pool document; the VM pool playbook_path becomes optional so the packaged document is the same in every profile
summary: Fresh-site seed pools come from a packaged seed document rather than adapter contributions

agent_position: Keep the playbook_path setting as it is, as the VM executor fallback and the playbook a VM pool without its own runs
owner_disposition: Rename playbook_path to vm_playbook_path, beside bare_metal_playbook_path, so each domain names its own service playbook
summary: The VM service playbook setting is renamed vm_playbook_path

agent_position: Promote four stated principles: P1 no implicit placement or capacity, P2 fresh-service defaults are ordinary overridable data, P3 domain-named service settings, P4 every entry point to one authority has the same effects
owner_disposition: Promote P1 (ARCHITECTURE.md) and P3 (DEPLOYMENT_AND_CONFIG.md); do not promote P2 or P4
summary: Only the no-implicit-sale and domain-named-setting principles are promoted
